contract: Published Server 2.11.1 service catalog administration (ServiceCatalogController, admin): POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/service-endpoints[/{endpoint}[/services[/{service}[/operations[/{operation}]]]]] registers a namespace's Nexus endpoints, their services and the services' operations by lowercased name. Creates validate like Laravel (names required, string, at most 191 characters, /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$/; descriptions at most 1000; metadata and policies arrays), answer 201 with a lowercase ULID and 409 with the existing id for a taken name. Operations require a sync or async mode, a handler binding kind and a non-empty handler_target_reference or handler_binding; a deadline_policy holds exactly timeout_seconds (1 to 2147483647) or an offset RFC3339 deadline_at within 1970-9999. Updates change only given fields, prohibit renaming an operation and repeat the binding check. Lookups answer 404 endpoint_not_found (with accepted false), service_not_found or operation_not_found, the parent first. Deletes refuse an endpoint with services, a service with operations, and succeed with outcome deleted. Endpoint lists are by name; service and operation lists in creation order. JSON documents read back as PHP arrays. The catalog reads under /api/service-catalog render the same rows by page and identity, and another namespace's identity is 404. Generated ids and whole-second times are placeholders; @own is the fixture's own namespace. Embedded applications have no HTTP catalog.
